# Campaign Cleaner

Campaign Cleaner is a tool designed to optimize email campaigns by ensuring compatibility across email clients, improving deliverability, and enhancing overall performance.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/campaign-cleaner/.

## Actions

- **Delete Campaign**: Delete a saved campaign by id.
- **Download Campaign PDF Analysis** (read-only): Download a pdf analysis report for a processed campaign.
- **Get Campaign List** (read-only): List all campaigns in the account.
- **Get Campaign Status** (read-only): Check the processing status of a submitted campaign.
